title: NWT STARBUCKS SPRING 2022 SIP SUSTAINABLY COLD CUP TUMBLER PLASTIC DRINKING 16oz
descriptionText:
No Lid - No Straw

This Starbucks Spring 2022 Sip Sustainably Cold Cup Tumbler is the perfect addition to your coffee and tea collection. With a capacity of 16oz, it is perfect for enjoying your favorite beverage on-the-go. The cup is made of durable plastic and features a blue color with the Starbucks logo on it. 

This item is an original and authentic Starbucks product, created in 2022. It is perfect for collectors and coffee lovers alike. Add it to your collection or use it to enjoy your favorite drink.
